title: About Me
paragraphs: As a Project Manager with over 5 years of experience in the tech industry, I combine strong technical expertise in Frontend Development (Angular, React) with proven leadership in managing cross-functional teams. I currently lead small to medium-sized teams to deliver responsive, user-centric web applications that align with business goals and client expectations.

My passion lies in transforming complex challenges into clear, actionable plans — ensuring smooth collaboration, maintaining project timelines, and driving high-quality outcomes. With a foundation in web development, I bring a unique perspective that bridges technical understanding and strategic project oversight.

Looking ahead, I aim to continue growing as a Project Management Professional while exploring opportunities in business analysis and digital transformation. My long-term aspiration is to apply my skills and leadership experience in Japan’s innovative tech industry, contributing to impactful projects that combine technology, creativity, and cultural collaboration.
If you’re looking for someone who can connect technical depth with effective management and communication, I’d be glad to connect and explore potential opportunities together.
